result.instructions: Tools for ClickTime, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many hours did I log last week, and on which jobs?"; "Log 2 hours on the Website Redesign job for today with the comment 'client call'."; "Which timesheets of mine are still open or rejected?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ClickTime data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clicktime_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clicktime_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clicktime_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. clicktime_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clicktime_get_me
tools.title: Get my user
tools.description: The ClickTime user this API token belongs to: id, name, email, security level (Standard, Manager, Admin), division, default task, approvers and timesheet preferences. The API token itself is never returned. GET /Me.

tools.name: clicktime_get_company
tools.title: Get company settings
tools.description: Company configuration: name, currency, week start, timesheet model, how the company names jobs/clients/tasks, restriction methods, and which optional modules are on (Expenses, TimeOffAccruals, SubJob phases). Call this first before using expense, time-off-request or phase tools. GET /Company.

tools.name: clicktime_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs (projects)
tools.description: List the jobs (projects) the token's user can log time to, by name, with job number, client, dates and active state. Use the ids to log time or filter entries. GET /Me/Jobs.

name.description: Only jobs with exactly this name.

job_number.description: Only the job with this job number.

client_id.description: Only jobs of this client id (see clicktime_list_clients).

is_active.description: true = active jobs only, false = inactive only (default: both).

my_jobs.description: true = only jobs assigned to the user (company job-list controls).

verbose.description: Also return the related Job/Client/Task/User objects and billable flags (slower, larger).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job (project) by id: name, number, client, start/end dates, active state. GET /Me/Jobs/{jobID}.

verbose.description: Also return the related Job/Client/Task/User objects and billable flags (slower, larger).

tools.name: clicktime_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients the token's user can see, with client number, short name and active state. GET /Me/Clients.

name.description: Only clients with exactly this name.

short_name.description: Only the client with this short name.

client_number.description: Only the client with this client number.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = inactive only (default: both).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the tasks (work categories) the token's user can log time against, with task code and active state. When the company restricts tasks per job, use clicktime_list_job_task_controls instead. GET /Me/Tasks.

name.description: Only tasks with exactly this name.

task_code.description: Only the task with this task code.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = inactive only (default: both).

my_tasks.description: true = only tasks assigned to the user.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_job_task_controls
tools.title: List valid job and task pairs
tools.description: The (job, task) combinations the user may log time on. Only valid when the company's TaskRestrictionMethod is 'byjob' (see clicktime_get_company); otherwise ClickTime answers 403. Active rows only unless filtered. GET /Me/Jobs/TaskControls.

job_id.description: Only pairs for this job id.

task_id.description: Only pairs for this task id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: List valid job and task pairs

tools.name: clicktime_list_job_phases
tools.title: List job phases
tools.description: The phases (sub-jobs, level 1) defined on a job. Needs the company's SubJob/phases module (see clicktime_get_company). Use the phase id when logging time on a phased job. GET /Me/Jobs/{jobID}/JobPhase.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_time_entries
tools.title: List my time entries
tools.description: List the token user's time entries, newest first: date, hours, job, task, comment, start/end time. Filter by one day (entry_date), a date range (start_date + end_date), job or task. Only days with logged time appear. Add verbose to get job/client names and the billable flag. GET /Me/TimeEntries.

start_date.description: First day of a date range (yyyy-mm-dd); use with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a date range, included (yyyy-mm-dd).

job_id.description: Only entries on this job id.

task_id.description: Only entries on this task id.

verbose.description: Also return the related Job/Client/Task/User objects and billable flags (slower, larger).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get time entry
tools.description: One of the user's time entries by id, with hours, comment, date, job, task, phase and custom fields. GET /Me/TimeEntries/{timeEntryID}.

verbose.description: Also return the related Job/Client/Task/User objects and billable flags (slower, larger).

tools.name: clicktime_list_timesheets
tools.title: List my timesheets
tools.description: List the user's timesheets (pay periods), newest first, with period dates, status (Open, Waiting, Approved, Rejected, Locked...), total hours and who submitted or approved. GET /Me/Timesheets.

status.description: Only timesheets in these states (Waiting = submitted and awaiting approval; submitted is the vendor's own alias).

from_date.description: Only timesheets ending on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only timesheets starting on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_get_timesheet_by_date
tools.title: Get timesheet covering a date
tools.description: The user's timesheet whose period contains a given day: period dates, status, day totals and the general actions (Submit, UndoSubmit...). GET /Me/Timesheets/{date}.

date.description: Any day inside the timesheet period.

tools.name: clicktime_list_timesheet_actions
tools.title: List actions available on my timesheet
tools.description: The status actions the user can take right now on the timesheet covering a date (Submit, UndoSubmit...). Check this before clicktime_submit_timesheet. GET /Me/Timesheets/{date}/Actions.

date.description: Any day inside the timesheet period.

annotations.title: List actions available on my timesheet

tools.name: clicktime_list_time_off_types
tools.title: List time off types and balances
tools.description: The time off types the user can take (vacation, sick...) with CurrentBalance, accrual and whether approval is required. Use for balance questions. GET /Me/TimeOffTypes.

is_active.description: true = active types only (the only ones that can be booked).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: List time off types and balances

tools.name: clicktime_list_time_off
tools.title: List my time off
tools.description: Time off the user has taken or booked, newest first: date, hours, type, notes. Not requests or balances. GET /Me/TimeOff.

from_date.description: Only entries on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only entries on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

time_off_type_id.description: Only this time off type id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List my time off requests
tools.description: The user's time off requests with status and dates. Needs the company's TimeOffAccruals module (see clicktime_get_company). GET /Me/TimeOffRequests.

status.description: Only requests in these statuses (Submitted = awaiting approval).

from_date.description: Only requests on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only requests on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_expense_sheets
tools.title: List my expense sheets
tools.description: The user's expense sheets with status, total and reimbursable amount, paid flag. Needs the company's Expenses module (see clicktime_get_company). GET /Me/ExpenseSheets.

from_date.description: Only sheets dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only sheets dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

status.description: Only sheets in these statuses (waiting = submitted for approval).

paid.description: true = paid sheets only, false = unpaid only.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_expense_items
tools.title: List my expense items
tools.description: The user's expense items: date, type, amount, description, job, billable flag, sheet. Receipt images are not fetched. Needs the Expenses module. GET /Me/ExpenseItems.

from_date.description: Only items dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only items dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

expense_sheet_id.description: Only items on this expense sheet id.

job_id.description: Only items charged to this job id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List people in the company with name, email, security level, division, approvers and active state. Needs a Manager or Admin token (others get 403). Cost and billing rates are included for Admins. GET /Users.

name.description: Only the user with exactly this name.

email.description: Only the user with this email.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = inactive only (default: both).

division_id.description: Only users in this division id.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_time_report
tools.title: Time report (company-wide)
tools.description: Company-wide time entries (what the Time report shows): date, user, job, client, task, hours, billable flag, rates. Filter by date range, user, job, client, task, division or billable. Needs an Admin, or a Manager allowed to run company reports. Up to 2500 rows per page. GET /Reports/Time.

is_billable.description: true = billable time only, false = non-billable only.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_time_summary
tools.title: Time summary (grouped)
tools.description: Hours, billable hours, billings and cost totals grouped by Job, Task, User, Month, Date or WorkType (several groupings combine, for example Job + User). Needs a Manager or Admin token. ClickTime requires at least one of job_id, user_id or task_id as a filter. GET /Reports/TimeSummary.

group_by.description: What to group the totals by: one of Job, Task, User, Month, Date, WorkType, or one of the pairs Task+User, Job+Task, Job+User, Job+Month.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: clicktime_create_time_entry
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: WRITE: log a time entry on the token user's own timesheet. Needs job_id and hours; task_id falls back to the user's default task; date defaults to today. Creates a NEW entry each call (not idempotent) and fails on a locked or submitted timesheet. Confirm date, hours, job, task and comment with the user first. POST /Me/TimeEntries.

task_id.description: Task id; omitted = the user's default task. Under per-job task restrictions it must be valid for the job.

comment.description: Comment, up to 2000 characters (some companies require one).

phase_id.description: Phase id, on companies with phases.

sub_phase_id.description: Sub-phase id, on companies with two phase levels.

dcaa_explanation.description: Explanation required by DCAA-enabled companies when changing a past date.

tools.name: clicktime_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update time entry
tools.description: WRITE: change one of the user's own time entries (hours, comment, job, task, start/end time, break). Only the fields you pass change; the date cannot be changed. Overwrites the previous values; a locked timesheet rejects it. Show the current and new values to the user first. PATCH /Me/TimeEntries/{timeEntryID}.

job_id.description: Move the entry to this job id.

task_id.description: Move the entry to this task id.

dcaa_explanation.description: Explanation required by DCAA-enabled companies when changing a past date.

tools.name: clicktime_submit_timesheet
tools.title: Submit or recall my timesheet
tools.description: WRITE: submit the user's timesheet covering a date for approval (action Submit), or recall it (UndoSubmit). Submitting locks the entries and notifies the approver; confirm with the user first. Check the available actions with clicktime_list_timesheet_actions first. POST /Me/Timesheets/{date}/Actions.

date.description: Any day inside the timesheet period.

action.description: Submit = send for approval; UndoSubmit = recall a submitted timesheet.

comment.description: Optional comment for the approver (up to 2000 characters).

has_attestation.description: true when the company requires attesting the timesheet is accurate and the user agrees.

tools.name: clicktime_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: WRITE: create a client. Needs an Admin, or a Manager allowed to add clients. Creates a NEW client each call (not idempotent); check clicktime_list_clients first to avoid duplicates. POST /Clients.

tools.name: clicktime_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: WRITE: create a job (project) under a client. Needs an Admin, or a Manager allowed to add jobs. Creates a NEW job each call (not idempotent); check clicktime_list_jobs first to avoid duplicates. POST /Jobs.

job_number.description: Job number, unique within the company (up to 50 characters).

is_billable.description: Billable (only when the company sets billability per job).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ClickTime
prompts.description: What you can do with ClickTime here, with example requests to try.
